title: Spider femur
concept: One thick upper leg segment of a giant spider.
sheet: Studio product photograph of a single long straight tapered cylinder sculpture, 2.6 m long and 0.35 m thick, a rounded knuckle at the left end, a slight waist in the middle, a swelling before a cupped socket at the right end, two thin ring grooves, a sparse row of short black thorns along the top, smooth satin dark brown-black lacquer with subtle reddish-brown mottling. Side view, lying horizontally, both ends fully in frame. A single object alone, nothing else, generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
notes: Budget: 1,500 triangles, 1K maps. Eight instances; stretched a little by the IK along its length.
